entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I assist you today?
I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago and it's just not working out for me.
I understand. Can I get your order number, please?
It's #VF12345. And honestly, I'm already pretty annoyed. I thought this VeloBand Pulse was going to be great, but it's been nothing but trouble. The heart rate monitor is wildly inaccurate.
Thank you. I see your order here. You purchased the VeloBand Pulse on July 10th. I'm sorry to hear you're having issues with it. Could you describe the problem with the heart rate tracking?
I just said it's wildly inaccurate! I'll be sitting at my desk and it'll say my heart rate is 150! Then when I'm actually working out, it's showing 70. It's useless. I want to return it.

I understand your frustration. Our standard return policy allows for returns up to 90 days after purchase. Since you're within that window, initiating a return is no problem. Let me go ahead and process that for you.
90 days? Really? I thought it was shorter than that. Well, great! Finally, something easy. Just get me that return label.

Yes, absolutely. The VeloFit return policy covers you for 90 days on most of our items. I’ve initiated the return process. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label via email within the next 24 hours. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location.
Okay, and how long until I see the refund on my card?

Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, the refund should appear in your account within 7-10 business days. I apologize again for the inconvenience you experienced with the smart watch. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thank you so much! You've been a great help. I was expecting a huge hassle. Appreciate it.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business. Have a great day!
